title: M006c/M006e.3 concurrency-race design analysis
hypothesis: The 2026-09-17 M006e.3 failure was caused by concurrent M006c state mutation and can be addressed post-observation without weakening the existing fail-closed hash-integrity check.
result: PASS: incident classified as contained local concurrency/state-race; M006e.3 failed closed with zero trading writes and no safety violation. Preferred post-observation remedy is scheduler serialization while preserving the existing before/after hash-integrity check.
